definitions: A long metal bar to which disks of varying weights are attached at each end, used for weightlifting and strength training.
A piece of body jewelry consisting of a small bar with a bead or ball at each end, used in piercings.
examples: He loaded the barbells with heavy plates for his deadlifts.
The gym had a rack full of barbells of different weights.
She chose a silver barbell for her new tongue piercing.
